purpose: measured sensitivity: geometry/mix main effect and the policy x mix interaction
SCALE_NOTE: bars are steps/delivery at 100 orders/run; valid only for a comparison at the same scale (enforced)
fault_design: pure map relabellings -- demand and request concurrency bit-identical, only placement moves
INTERPRETATION: report any null as 'no detectable effect at a measured sensitivity of X steps/delivery'. The overall/mix/interaction bars are DIFFERENT BASES and must never be interchanged.
PASS_RULE_CORRECTION: Original rule additionally required 0 null exceedances of a bar computed as the 95th percentile OF THE SAME null sample. For n<=20 numpy interpolates the 95th percentile strictly below the maximum, so >=1 exceedance is GUARANTEED -- the rule was mathematically unsatisfiable and the FAIL it produced on 2026-07-31 22:54 was spurious. Measurements are UNCHANGED; only the pass rule was corrected and PASS recomputed from the saved data. A real false-positive control needs an INDEPENDENT redraw set.
INTERACTION_UNDERPOWERED: size_skew moves the closed-form large-minus-small differential by +1.47 steps/pick yet the measured interaction moved only +0.178 against a 0.419 bar, and the planted interaction fired 0/4, 0/4, 1/4. The policy x mix INTERACTION is NOT resolvable at this scale (~5x more draws needed). Any null interaction from the comparison is uninterpretable and must be reported as underpowered, not as absence of an interaction.
